O-GlcNAc Workbench

Predict sites and compare Atlas and OGT-PIN evidence. Your sequences stay in your browser.

FASTA input

Choose a file with one or more protein sequences.

UniProt accessions in FASTA headers enable evidence matching. Other identifiers still receive predictions.

Predictions prioritize experiments; they are not experimental evidence. No composite score is calculated.

How to interpret prediction and evidence

O-GlcNAcPRED-DL 1.0 · human and mouse

  1. Prediction reports the published model score.
  2. Atlas reports exact accession, species, residue, and position matches.
  3. OGT-PIN reports accession-and-species OGT interaction evidence.
